BiblicalUsage: Karbela is a mantle — the outer garment, named among the clothes the three friends wore into the furnace: bound in their coats, their hosen, and their hats, and their other garments, and cast into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the mantle is part of the miracle: they went in fully clothed, and came out with not even the smell of fire on their garments.
RelatedEvents: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the Fiery Furnace
